headline: Huntington Ingalls (HII) Lands Major Submarine Awards That Extend Newport News Pipeline
summary: Huntington Ingalls Industries secured major contracts for Block VI Virginia class submarines. The company also received awards tied to Build II Columbia class submarines and related infrastructure. These wins extend Newport News Shipbuilding’s submarine construction pipeline over multiple years. Huntington Ingalls Industries (NYSE:HII) is moving into the spotlight again with this fresh round of nuclear submarine awards.
